title: slack-notice config
description: ~/.config/slack-notice/config.yaml (XDG respected) plus config.d/*.yaml in lexical order. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Drop-ins: maps merge. Precedence: flags, then config, then defaults; there are no environment overrides. Files are parsed with yaml.safe_load, at most 65536 bytes. Self-contained: no external references.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive finite number, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds); zero is refused. Booleans are never accepted. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

enabled.description: false makes send exit 22 without reading input or the credential.

webhook_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the trigger URL. The URL itself is never in config.

body_variable.description: Name of the workflow's text variable.

level_prefix.description: One-line prefixes, 1 to 16 characters each; a value that the sanitizer would change is config_invalid at load.

max_chars.description: Body limit in Unicode code points; a fixed 12000-byte cap also applies.

timeout.description: The one wall-clock deadline of a send (input, lock wait, network, retries), 3s to 120s.
